name: shot
purpose: The camera of a scene: a named shot. The scene finds the framing, and it moves to the newest shot that shows, with easing.
binds: a state key with the shot name (optional)

name.doc: wide, side, front, top or close:<body id>

bind.doc: a state key that holds the shot name; the board's cam operation sets it

step.doc: the shot starts at this step of the scene
